scope: Production-bridge native scene probes and Chromium browser-to-native-host candidate runs on four hosted OS/architecture runners, plus separate focused WebKit browser runs on both Mac architectures. Actual browser mouse actions verify held dragging and stationary holds create no saved revision, release creates exactly one revision, subsequent hover cannot change the value or write again, pointer capture is clear and the cursor is default. Both Mac WebKit runs additionally check inside/outside release, canceled native range tracking without delayed writes, refresh focus preservation and saved-level reload. These are Playwright browsers against native host APIs: neither browser engine verifies mouse event forwarding through the dedicated Mac WKWebView or Windows WebView2 window. Candidate binaries are checksum checked and their embedded clean full source SHA, Go runtime, CGO mode and target are inspected without executing them on the collector. Native scene probes separately measure Mac native envelope × track × master gain and independent fades. Windows audio gain/fade measurements require an enumerated active endpoint; absent audio is recorded explicitly. Browser settings checks preserve playback identity and persist independent enables with unequal 1.2-second audio / 0.6-second visual fades, but do not measure native gains. Background-toggle music preservation is verified only with an audio endpoint. Physical speaker/projector output, stage smoothness, hardware routing and the user’s physical Mac drag are not verified. This candidate evidence does not by itself verify published release assets.
sanitization: Selected native probe measurements and browser test outcomes only; source JSON/archive hashes retained. No device identifiers, host paths, cookies, CSRF values, raw stdout/stderr or workflow logs copied into this summary. Raw artifacts remain in this private audit directory.

readOnlyDiagnosis.staticRace: The phase gate observes asynchronous AVPlayerLayer readiness before the native prime-seek/KVO callbacks queued through onMain necessarily finish reporting paused and rendering the ready layer. The elapsed threshold is measured from scene request, not readiness completion.
readOnlyDiagnosis.interpretation: A reachable verifier-readiness race exists, but the original log has insufficient measurements to prove which condition caused this run to fail. No product fix or tolerance increase is justified from this evidence alone.
readOnlyDiagnosis.recommendedFocusedVerifierChange: Wait within the existing bounded probe deadline for completed native preparation and observed paused transport acknowledgement. Throughout that wait, continue failing on any started/rate/clock advance or playing event. Retain the existing mute, first-frame and visibility assertions after readiness, and print exact bounded scalar/boolean measurements on assertion failure or timeout.
